title: Verb + two objects
summary: Глаголы с двумя дополнениями: **give me a book / give a book to me**, выбор **to** или **for**, глаголы только с одной моделью и пассив.
ru:
## Две модели: IO + DO и DO + to/for + IO
Многие глаголы могут иметь два дополнения: **косвенное** (indirect object, IO — кому/для кого) и **прямое** (direct object, DO — что).
1. **глагол + IO + DO**: > She gave **her sister a watch**. — Она подарила сестре часы.
2. **глагол + DO + to/for + IO**: > She gave **a watch to her sister**.
> He sent **me an invitation**. = He sent **an invitation to me**. — Он прислал мне приглашение.
Выбор зависит от **информационного фокуса**: новая или важная информация ставится в конец. Отвечая на «Кому она подарила часы?», скажем *She gave the watch **to her sister***. Длинное дополнение тоже лучше ставить в конец: *He gave Anna **a book on the history of Central Asian trade routes**.*
Если оба дополнения — местоимения, стандартный порядок — с **to**: *Give **it to me**.* (форма *Give me it* встречается в британской разговорной речи, но в письме её лучше избегать).

## To или for?
- **to** — передача, адресат: **give, lend, offer, owe, pass, pay, post, promise, sell, send, show, teach, tell, write, hand, bring**. > Could you **pass the salt to me**?
- **for** — в чьих-то интересах, ради кого-то: **buy, make, cook, find, get, order, save, keep, book, fetch, build, leave, pour**. > I'll **make a coffee for you** = I'll **make you a coffee**.
С **for** возможен и смысл «вместо»: *I'll sign it **for you*** (от вашего имени). Сравните: *Could you open the door **for me**?* — здесь me не косвенное дополнение, а «в мою пользу».

## Глаголы только с одной моделью
- **Только DO + to + IO**: **explain, describe, suggest, announce, say, mention, introduce, propose, report, admit, confess, repeat**. > ~~Explain me the problem.~~ → Explain the problem **to me**. > ~~She suggested me a hotel.~~ → She suggested a hotel **to me**.
- **Только IO + DO** (без to/for): **ask** (a question), **cost, charge, fine, envy, forgive, spare, save, wish, bet, deny, refuse, allow**. > The repair **cost us** a fortune. > She **wished us** a pleasant journey. > The firm **fined him** €5,000. > **Spare me** the details.
О просьбе: *Could I **ask you** a favour?* (формально: *ask a favour **of** you*).

## Пассив с двумя дополнениями
Подлежащим может стать любое дополнение. Чаще — **IO**, потому что это человек: > **I was given** a ticket. — Мне дали билет. > **He was sent** a reminder.
Если важнее вещь, берём DO и добавляем **to / for**: > **A ticket was given to** me. > **A drink was bought for** her.
С глаголами, допускающими только DO + to, IO-пассив невозможен: ~~I was explained the rule.~~ → **The rule was explained to me.**

## Устойчивые сочетания
Много «лёгких» глаголов образуют фразы с двумя дополнениями, где IO — иногда не человек:
> I'll **give you a call** tomorrow. — Я вам завтра позвоню.
> Could you **do me a favour**? — Окажете мне услугу?
> **Give it a try.** — Попробуйте. (IO здесь — вещь, а не человек)
> The noise **gave me a headache**. — От шума у меня разболелась голова.
> **Pay him a visit.** — Навестите его.

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~Explain me this rule.~~ → Explain this rule **to me**.
- ~~She cooked a meal to us.~~ → She cooked a meal **for us**.
- ~~It cost to us a lot of money.~~ → It cost **us** a lot of money.
- ~~She gave to me it.~~ → She gave **it to me**.
- ~~Describe me the man.~~ → Describe the man **to me**.
en:
## Two patterns: IO + DO and DO + to/for + IO
Many verbs can have two objects: an **indirect object** (IO — who receives or benefits) and a **direct object** (DO — what).
1. **verb + IO + DO**: > She gave **her sister a watch**.
2. **verb + DO + to/for + IO**: > She gave **a watch to her sister**.
> He sent **me an invitation**. = He sent **an invitation to me**.
The choice depends on **information focus**: new or important information goes at the end. To answer "Who did she give the watch to?" we say *She gave the watch **to her sister***. A long object also goes last: *He gave Anna **a book on the history of Central Asian trade routes**.*
When both objects are pronouns, the standard order uses **to**: *Give **it to me**.* (*Give me it* is heard in British speech but avoided in writing).

## To or for?
- **to** — transfer, direction: **give, lend, offer, owe, pass, pay, post, promise, sell, send, show, teach, tell, write, hand, bring**. > Could you **pass the salt to me**?
- **for** — benefit, on someone's behalf: **buy, make, cook, find, get, order, save, keep, book, fetch, build, leave, pour**. > I'll **make a coffee for you** = I'll **make you a coffee**.
**For** can also mean "instead of": *I'll sign it **for you**.*

## Verbs with only one pattern
- **Only DO + to + IO**: **explain, describe, suggest, announce, say, mention, introduce, propose, report, admit, confess, repeat**. > ~~Explain me the problem.~~ → Explain the problem **to me**.
- **Only IO + DO** (no to/for): **ask** (a question), **cost, charge, fine, envy, forgive, spare, save, wish, bet, deny, refuse, allow**. > The repair **cost us** a fortune. > She **wished us** a pleasant journey. > **Spare me** the details.

## Passives with two objects
Either object can become the subject. The **IO** is more common because it is a person: > **I was given** a ticket. > **He was sent** a reminder.
If the thing is more important, we use the DO and keep **to / for**: > **A ticket was given to** me. > **A drink was bought for** her.
With verbs that allow only DO + to, an IO passive is impossible: ~~I was explained the rule.~~ → **The rule was explained to me.**

## Fixed phrases
Many common verbs form phrases with two objects: > I'll **give you a call** tomorrow. > Could you **do me a favour**? > **Give it a try.** > The noise **gave me a headache**.

## Common mistakes
- ~~Explain me this rule.~~ → Explain this rule **to me**.
- ~~She cooked a meal to us.~~ → She cooked a meal **for us**.
- ~~It cost to us a lot of money.~~ → It cost **us** a lot of money.
- ~~She gave to me it.~~ → She gave **it to me**.
structure:
## Модели
| Модель | Формула | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| IO + DO | verb + IO + DO | She **sent me** a **postcard**. |
| DO + to | verb + DO + to + IO | She sent a **postcard to me**. |
| DO + for | verb + DO + for + IO | She **bought** a gift **for me**. |
| только DO + to | explain / suggest / describe + DO + to + IO | He **explained** the rule **to us**. |
| только IO + DO | cost / ask / fine / wish + IO + DO | It **cost us** a lot. |

## to или for
| Группа | Глаголы |
|---|---|
| **to** (передача) | give, lend, offer, owe, pass, pay, post, promise, sell, send, show, teach, tell, write, hand, bring |
| **for** (выгода) | buy, make, cook, find, get, order, save, keep, book, fetch, build, leave |
| только IO + DO | ask, cost, charge, fine, envy, forgive, spare, wish, bet, allow, deny |
| только DO + to | explain, describe, suggest, announce, mention, introduce, propose, say |

## Пассив
| Тип | Формула | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| IO — подлежащее | IO + be + V3 + DO | **I was given** a ticket. |
| DO — подлежащее | DO + be + V3 + to/for + IO | A ticket **was given to** me. |

items.text: The lawyer explained the clause {{to}} us in detail.
I'll fetch a glass of water {{for}} you.
Ben made a delicious lemon cake {{for}} Maria's birthday.
The company offered a better deal {{to}} its loyal customers.
Could you save a seat {{for}} me?
He described the burglar {{to}} the police.
She bought a bunch of flowers {{for}} her grandmother.

exercises.title: Другая модель
exercises.instruction: Перепишите вторую часть предложения с to или for.

items.text: He gave his daughter a bicycle. = He gave a bicycle {{to his daughter}}.
I'll buy you a coffee. = I'll buy a coffee {{for you}}.
She showed the visitors the garden. = She showed the garden {{to the visitors}}.
She wrote the committee a letter. = She wrote a letter {{to the committee}}.
Dad cooked us a huge breakfast. = Dad cooked a huge breakfast {{for us}}.
They lent the neighbours their ladder. = They lent their ladder {{to the neighbours}}.
Can you pass me the salt? = Can you pass the salt {{to me}}?
Leo found his sister a flat. = Leo found a flat {{for his sister}}.

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Ответьте полными предложениями, используя два дополнения.

items.prompt: Who did you last send a message or a postcard to? What did you write?
items.sample: I sent my sister a message about our weekend plans.

items.prompt: What is the best present someone has given you?
items.sample: My grandfather gave me his old watch.

items.prompt: What can you cook for your friends?
items.sample: I can cook my friends a simple pasta dinner.

items.prompt: Whom would you like to do a favour? What favour?
items.sample: I'd like to do my neighbour a favour and water her plants.

items.prompt: What did your last holiday cost you?
items.sample: It cost me about a thousand euros.
